task.instructions: Using matplotlib, draw a line chart of server load for one day: 24 hourly samples 32, 30, 28, 27, 26, 28, 35, 48, 62, 70, 74, 76, 78, 77, 75, 72, 70, 66, 58, 50, 45, 40, 36, 34 (percent, hours 00:00 to 23:00). function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command": "cat > plot.py <<'PY'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4.5))
load = [32, 30, 28, 27, 26, 28, 35, 48, 62, 70, 74, 76, 78, 77, 75, 72, 70,
        66, 58, 50, 45, 40, 36, 34]
hours = [f"{h:02d}:00" for h in range(24)]
ax.plot(hours, load, marker="o", markersize=3)
ax.set_xticks(range(24))
ax.set_xticklabels(hours)                  # horizontal, on a narrow canvas
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_title("Server load by hour")
ax.set_xlabel("Hour"); ax.set_ylabel("Load (%)")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figure.png", dpi=100)
PY
python plot.py"}
